swimming_pool.evidence: The pools visible at the bottom and bottom-right are outside the yellow outline and belong to neighbouring lots.

signals.notes: The lot has a multi-section brown-roofed house, a large tree canopy at the north, a patchy dry lawn, and a small patio area at the southwest corner of the house. A dark vehicle sits near the north side of the house, and the paved driveway to the east lies mostly outside the outline.
